Blasting Block!
Blasting Block VR – THE NEXT DIMENSION OF PUZZLE SOLVING

Step into a world where puzzles come to life! If you loved the classic block-matching gameplay on mobile, Blasting Block VR takes that passion to a whole new dimension. Forget tapping a screen—now you can reach out, grab, and master the board with your own hands.

Key Features:
Tactile Physics Interaction: Use your Touch Controllers (or Hand Tracking) to pick up, rotate, and snap blocks into the 8x8 grid with satisfying precision.

Immersive Environments: Solve puzzles in stunning 360° environments, from minimalist zen lofts to breathtaking cosmic vistas designed to help you focus and relax.

Explosive Combo Mechanics: Clear multiple rows and columns to trigger spectacular visual effects and spatial audio cues right in front of your eyes.

Infinite & Adventure Modes: Push your limits in the endless Classic mode or journey through hundreds of unique levels in the Adventure quest.

Brain Training & Relaxation: The perfect blend of mental stimulation and stress relief, built specifically for the VR experience.

Are you ready to shatter your high score in a world without limits?
Download now and start blasting!
